prompt:
Build the machine-checkable architecture for bringing the separately managed estate in `inventory/estate.json` into the existing VCF fleet as a workload domain, without changing any management-domain component. Use `compatibility/compatibility-snapshot.json` as the pinned authority for the submitted versions, targets, gates, and transition order.

Before implementing, use your network research tools to consult live, reachable Broadcom-published compatibility/interoperability and upgrade-path sources for the listed vCenter, ESXi, vSAN, NSX, vSphere Replication, and VMware Live Site Recovery versions and their 9.1 targets. Record the sources you actually consulted in `research-sources.json` as a JSON object with a `sources` array containing at least two entries. Each source must have non-empty `title`, HTTPS Broadcom `url`, `retrievedAt` date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form, and non-empty `claims` array fields. Choose the sources and searches yourself; the pinned snapshot remains the grading authority if the live material has changed.

Implement `VcfBrownfieldArchitecture/VcfBrownfieldArchitecture.psd1` and `.psm1` as a PowerShell module exporting `New-VcfBrownfieldMigrationPlan`. The environment already provides `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer` and `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager`; declare them as required modules, drive SddcSpec construction through the VMware.Sdk.Vcf installer initializer cmdlets, and do not vendor VMware modules. The function must accept `-InventoryPath`, `-CompatibilitySnapshotPath`, and `-OutputPath` and write the architecture as `migration-plan.json`.

The artifact must conform to `schemas/brownfield-migration-plan.schema.json`. Its `sddcSpec` must describe reuse of the fixture's existing workload vCenter, hosts, datastore, networks, and NSX deployment and validate as `SddcSpec` against `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json`, which is pinned from tag `9.1.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs`. The ordered plan must name every workload-estate component, its exact current version, target product/version, disposition, and technical gates; import the estate into the existing fleet before component transitions; preserve the management domain; and follow the pinned transition sequence. Produce the architecture artifacts, not a prose design document. Run `python3 -B verify.py` when finished.
